articles.headline: World Cup Daily live: Haaland latest star to inspire baby name boom
articles.description: Enjoy all the features, news, video analysis and color from around the 2026 World Cup as we build up to the first semifinal -- France vs. Spain.

articles.headline: Barcelona edge Atlético Madrid, Arsenal as club with most players in 2026 World Cup semis
articles.description: Spanish champions Barcelona have more players than any other club still competing for World Cup glory.

articles.headline: Forget Wonderwall, England's World Cup semifinal opponents Argentina have their own special anthem too
articles.description: One of the defining images of this World Cup has been England's full-time rendition of Wonderwall in unison with the fans. They're not the only team to have generated a bond with their travelling support however.

articles.headline: Diego Maradona Jr.: England semifinal a 'special occasion' for Argentina
articles.description: Diego Maradona Jr., son of the late Argentina legend Diego Maradona, described Wednesday's World Cup semifinal clash against England as a "special occasion" for his fellow countrymen and by no means an "ordinary game."

articles.headline: Lamine Yamal: Spain, France semifinal my 'most important match,' I'm not afraid
articles.description: Spain winger Lamine Yamal has described the World Cup semifinal against France as "the most important match" in his career.

articles.headline: Folarin Balogun joins Klutch Sports agency after breakout World Cup
articles.description: United States forward Folarin Balogun has signed with LeBron James' agency Klutch Sports following a breakout World Cup that elevated his profile on and off the pitch.
